NUGGET.gloss: a solid lump of a precious metal as found in the earth
NUGGET.definition: A solid lump of a precious metal (especially gold) as found in the earth.

TUNE.gloss: a succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence
TUNE.definition: A succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence.
TUNE.example: She was humming an air from Beethoven.

TUNG.gloss: Chinese tree bearing seeds that yield tung oil
TUNG.definition: Chinese tree bearing seeds that yield tung oil.

GET.gloss: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
GET.definition: Come into the possession of something concrete or abstract.
GET.example: She got a lot of paintings from her uncle.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

GUN.gloss: a weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity
GUN.definition: A weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity (especially from a metal tube or barrel).

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

EGG.gloss: animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and…
EGG.definition: Animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and protective envelopes; especially the thin-shelled reproductive body laid by e.g. female birds.

GEN.example: Give me the gen on your new line of computers.

GUT.gloss: the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus
GUT.definition: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.
